gameDescriptionHtml:
You are a Viking warrior, stranded in a hostile land in between the human realm and Valhalla. With nothing but your wits and determination, you begin to gather survivors and resources to build a new village. As you carve out a home in this rugged landscape, you must defend your people from the fallen warriors. Your journey will take you across vast territories. Through strength and strategy, lead your people to glory and secure your place in the sagas of Valhalla.

Game Features

  • Village Building: Start from humble beginnings and build your village from the ground up. Construct homes, fortifications, workshops, and more to create a stronghold that can withstand the trials of the Viking Age.
  • Resource Management: Hunt, gather, and mine essential resources to keep your village thriving. Balance your needs for food, materials, and trade to ensure your people prosper.
  • Combat and Conquest: Lead your warriors into battle against rival camps and mythical creatures. Use strategy and brute force to conquer new territories and expand your influence.
  • In-Depth Crafting System: Craft tools, weapons, and clothing from raw materials gathered in the environment. Experiment with different combinations and qualities to create gear tailored to specific tasks and combat scenarios.
  • Exploration and discovery, fight the dead alongside your companions, find and recruit companions.
